pages: Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands on the wharf holding one survey plot sheet, looking at brown water across the river mouth. Middle distance: bollards, a mooring chain, a dredge pipe. Background: the far bank, low cloud, morning light.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, leans over the rail with one hand on the transducer pole. Middle distance: the sounder box, a coil of cable, black fenders. Background: the bar breaking white, a grey sea, the launch hull.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands at the multibeam console with one hand on the trackball, watching soundings spread. Middle distance: a second screen, the helm, a mug. Background: the wheelhouse window, grey water sliding past.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, holds one yellow measuring pole against a painted mark on the rail. Middle distance: the transducer, a notebook, a coil of rope. Background: the wharf wall, low sun on the water.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands at the office window with one printed survey plot flat in her hand, the channel below. Middle distance: a desk, a telephone, a mug. Background: wharf cranes, brown river water, overcast.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, sits at the desk turned towards one monitor of grey soundings, hand on the mouse. Middle distance: a hard drive, a folder, a mug. Background: the office window, the harbour, flat light.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, sits in the launch with one brown envelope on her knee, a pencil making sums on the back of it. Middle distance: the console, a thermos, the helm. Background: the wharf wall through the window, engine light.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands at the launch rail with one grease pencil in her hand, looking down at the water. Middle distance: the console, a mug, the transducer pole. Background: the wharf, the brown bar, low sun.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, kneels at the concrete wharf wall with one hand on a brass bolt set in the concrete. Middle distance: a levelling staff, an open tool case, a tape. Background: the river, a mudbank, grey light.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, leans over one graduated tide staff at the wharf, hand flat on the wet metal. Middle distance: a notebook, a rope, a stilling well. Background: the river running out, distant breakers, grey morning.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, kneels in the launch at the driven pile, one pressure sensor held above the stilling well. Middle distance: a spanner, a rope coil, a toolbox. Background: the bar going brown, flat falling water.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, sits at the console with one plotted sheet spread flat under her hand, a finger on the narrow neck of the loop. Middle distance: the trackball, a mug, the window rail. Background: grey water, the far shore.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, sits at the wheelhouse table with one paper hopper ticket in her hand, a pencil resting beside it. Middle distance: a folder, a mug, the console. Background: the sea beyond the glass, low sun.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands on the lip of the cut holding one ranging rod upright while the sand face slumps. Middle distance: the dredger hull, a marker buoy, a ladder. Background: the surf line, breakers, a southerly sky.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands at a boardroom table with one bound report open under her hand. Middle distance: a water glass, a folder, a pen. Background: the window wall, the harbour, flat light.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands beside the table with one telephone handset in her hand, the closed report on the desk. Middle distance: a mug, a chair, a coat. Background: the harbour through the window, overcast.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, pins one printed notice sheet to the harbour board, one palm flat on it. Middle distance: a clipboard, a pencil, the board frame. Background: a ship's mast, wharf cranes, morning.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, sets one levelling staff upright on the wharf with both hands. Middle distance: a tripod, a toolbox, a tape. Background: the bar and the driven pile, flat water, overcast.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, writes on the back of one brass plate housing at the foot of the staff, a grease pencil in her fingers. Middle distance: the staff, a stilling well, a notebook. Background: the wharf deck, the river, low sun.

Riria, a woman of thirty-six, black hair in a low plait, a red foul-weather jacket over a yellow buoyancy vest, rubber boots, stands at the launch rail with one grease pencil in her hand, watching the bar go brown. Middle distance: the console, a fender, the transducer pole. Background: flat water, low sun, the river mouth.
